TextContext.SourceString: 狂热的粉丝们在四处寻找着他们崇拜的偶像。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Frenzied fans are searching everywhere for the idol they adore.

TextContext.SourceString: 但是在尚未被注意的地方，一个粉白发色、灵活如小鹿般的少女悄悄溜出了人群的视线。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But in a place no one notices, a girl with pink-white hair, light on her feet like a deer, quietly slips out of the crowd.

TextContext.SourceString: （我和往常一样去星庇所上班，周围过于簇拥的人群似乎和我毫无关联。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I head to work at Astral Sanctuary like usual. The crowd packed around me feels like it has nothing to do with me.)

TextContext.SourceString: （直到……我在小巷里听见了一阵急促的脚步声。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Until... I hear a set of hurried footsteps coming from a nearby alley.)

TextParam.LocalizedString: Who just ran straight into me?

TextContext.SourceString: （我正打算开口询问……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I'm about to say something—)

TextContext.SourceString: 嘘！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Shh!

TextContext.SourceString: （少女朝我俏皮地眨了一下眼睛。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The girl gives me a playful wink.)

TextContext.SourceString: （她看上去有些眼熟。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (She looks kind of familiar.)

TextContext.SourceString: （是香奈美！拉薇曾经给我介绍过这位当红偶像歌手的情况，以及她的隐藏身份。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (It's Kanami! Lawine once told me about this top idol singer, including her hidden identity.)

TextContext.SourceString: （而我们也算是在某些任务的现场打过照面了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (We've also crossed paths during a few missions before.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我还没来得及细想，就被香奈美拉着躲到了墙角。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Before I can think any further, Kanami grabs me and pulls me into the corner.)

TextContext.SourceString: 该怎么办呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What should we do?

TextContext.SourceString: 路口隐隐约约地传来了人声。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Voices drift faintly from the street.

TextContext.SourceString: （香奈美的呼吸变得急促，眼神有些闪烁，她似乎这才意识到和我的距离太近了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Kanami's breathing quickens, her eyes flicker. She seems to realize how close we are.)

TextContext.SourceString: （但她没有躲闪……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (But she doesn't pull away...)

TextContext.SourceString: （总觉得，她似乎有什么话想对我说。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (It feels like she wants to say something.)

TextContext.SourceString: （人声渐渐远了，那些寻找香奈美的人似乎往其他方向找去了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The voices gradually fade. The people searching for Kanami seem to have gone another way.)

TextContext.SourceString: （但是，现在出去的话，太容易被发现了……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (But if we step out now, it would be too easy to get spotted...)

TextContext.SourceString: （我把目光转向了香奈美，从她的眼神中读到同样的疑惑和不安，以及一份期待。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I look at Kanami. In her eyes, I see the same uncertainty and unease... and a hint of anticipation.)

TextContext.SourceString: 可以请你帮我做个掩护吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Will you cover for Kanami?

TextContext.SourceString: （香奈美露出了惹人怜爱的表情，用撒娇的语气向我求助。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Kanami puts on an endearing expression, her voice soft and slightly pleading.)

TextContext.SourceString: 没问题。
TextContext.LocalizedString: No problem.

TextContext.SourceString: （为了不引人注目，我给香奈美戴上了鸭舌帽，还将随身的外套披在了她的身上。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (To avoid drawing attention, I put a baseball cap on Kanami and drape my jacket over her shoulders.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我去前方探了一下路……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I move ahead first to check the situation...)

TextContext.SourceString: （在确认时机合适后，我牵起了香奈美的手，带她离开了人群密集的商业区。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Once the timing feels right, I take Kanami's hand and lead her out of the crowded commercial district.)

TextContext.SourceString: （最终成功地将香奈美送回了住所。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (In the end, I safely get her back home.)

TextContext.SourceString: 走进住所……
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Inside her place...)

TextContext.SourceString: 映入眼帘的是一个干净又清爽的客厅。
TextContext.LocalizedString: A clean, bright living room comes into view.

TextContext.SourceString: 你坐在沙发上等我一下哦，我回房间换件衣服。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Sit on the couch and wait for me, okay? I'll go change.

TextContext.SourceString: （香奈美朝我俏皮地眨了一下眼睛，转身走进了房间。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Kanami gives me a playful wink before heading into her room.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我听见了……悉悉嗦嗦衣服布料摩擦的声音，还有轻轻哼出的歌声。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I can hear the soft rustling of fabric... and a gentle tune she is humming.)

TextContext.SourceString: （虽然发生了刚才的事，但似乎没有影响她的心情。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After everything that just happened, it does not seem to have affected her mood at all.)

TextContext.SourceString: （轻哼的歌声轻快而流畅，让我的心情也舒适了很多……应该是她非常喜爱的曲子？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The melody is light and smooth. Just listening to it makes me feel at ease... it must be a song she really likes.)

TextContext.SourceString: （不知道过了多久，香奈美突然凑到了我的面前。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I am not sure how much time passes before Kanami suddenly leans in right in front of me.)

TextContext.SourceString: 久等啦~
TextContext.LocalizedString: Sorry to keep you waiting.

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美穿着一身淡黄色的短裙，尽显少女的娇俏。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami is now wearing a light yellow dress, full of soft, girlish charm.

TextContext.SourceString: 多亏你的帮忙，我才能顺利到家。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Thanks to you, I made it home safely.

TextContext.SourceString: 作为我的恩人，你想要什么谢礼呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: As my hero, what kind of reward would you like?

TextContext.SourceString: 能够帮到你是我的荣幸。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm just glad I could help.

TextContext.SourceString: 给我谢礼？
TextContext.LocalizedString: A reward?

TextContext.SourceString: 诶嘿，不如香奈美送你一张演唱会前排的门票吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hehe, how about a front-row ticket to my concert?

TextContext.SourceString: 我出道以来所有唱过的单曲，你都可以在这场演出中听到哦！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Every single I've ever performed since my debut. You can hear all of them there!

TextContext.SourceString: （做思考状）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Think about it.)

TextContext.SourceString: 除此之外……
TextContext.LocalizedString: And on top of that...

TextContext.SourceString: 我可以再附赠你一份亲笔签名照哦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I can even give you a signed photo.

TextContext.SourceString: 无论是什么，香奈美都可以满足你的！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Whatever you want, Kanami can make it happen!

TextContext.SourceString: （看着香奈美过于热情的表现，我决定逗一逗香奈美。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Seeing how enthusiastic she is, I decide to tease her a little.)

TextContext.SourceString: 最近有个火爆全网的视频。
TextContext.LocalizedString: There's a video going viral online lately.

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美的脸唰的一下就变得通红。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami's face instantly turns bright red.

TextContext.SourceString: 你说的……不会是我刚出道时跳的扭扭舞吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You don't mean... that dance from my debut, right?

TextContext.SourceString: 最近，香奈美早年间参加节目的视频又被翻了出来，还掀起了模仿热潮。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Recently, an old clip from her early days resurfaced and sparked a wave of imitations.

TextContext.SourceString: 原来你也刷到那个视频了吗？也太难为情啦……
TextContext.LocalizedString: So you saw it too? That's so embarrassing...

TextContext.SourceString: 如果你真的很想看我表演的话，我也可……
TextContext.LocalizedString: If you really want to see me perform it, I could—

TextContext.SourceString: 别随便答应奇怪的要求啊。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Don't just agree to weird requests like that.

TextContext.SourceString: 你怎么能没有戒备心……
TextContext.LocalizedString: You need to be more careful.

TextContext.SourceString: 欸？！这么说来……你是在担心我吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Huh?! Wait... are you worried about me?

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美只是对你没有防备啦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami just does not put her guard up around you.

TextContext.SourceString: 这样，我才能和你更亲近呀！
TextContext.LocalizedString: That way, I can be closer to you!

TextContext.SourceString: （香奈美充满粉红泡泡的主动攻势，令我有些招架不住。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Kanami's openly affectionate approach catches me off guard.)

TextContext.SourceString: （看来香奈美对我产生了兴趣。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (It seems like Kanami has taken an interest in me.)

TextContext.SourceString: 艾顿城金树区，辉夜场馆前。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Arton City's Golden Tree District, in front of Kaguya Hall.

TextContext.SourceString: （我如约赶到了现场参加香奈美的演唱会。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I arrived right on time for Kanami's concert.)

TextContext.SourceString: 这里的气氛格外热闹，耀眼的舞台灯光照亮了整个天空。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The atmosphere here is incredibly lively. Dazzling stage lights light up the entire sky.

TextContext.SourceString: （取票。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Picking up my ticket.)

TextContext.SourceString: （这就是SSVIP门票尊享的服务吗？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Is this what SSVIP service is like?)

TextContext.SourceString: （在工作人员的带领下，我从快速通道进入了会场。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Guided by the staff, I entered the venue through a fast lane.)

TextContext.SourceString: （并且很轻易地找到了香奈美安排的内场座位。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (And it was easy to find the front-row seat Kanami arranged for me.)

TextContext.SourceString: 视野不错。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Nice view.

TextContext.SourceString: （就座之后，我观察起了周围的情况……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After sitting down, I started looking around...)

TextContext.SourceString: 这个能容纳数以万计观众的巨型会场内基本上座无虚席。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The massive venue, capable of holding tens of thousands, is almost completely full.

TextContext.SourceString: 随处可见那些举着应援横幅或者挥舞着粉紫色荧光棒的粉丝们。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Everywhere I look, fans are holding support banners or waving pink and purple glow sticks.

TextContext.SourceString: 快看，香奈美出场了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Look, Kanami is coming out!

TextContext.SourceString: 众人纷纷朝着舞台望去。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Everyone turns their eyes toward the stage.

TextContext.SourceString: 伴随着灯光和音乐的呼应，香奈美从上空缓缓降临到了舞台中央，动情地唱起了开场曲。
TextContext.LocalizedString: With lights and music perfectly in sync, Kanami slowly descends from above onto center stage, singing the opening song with emotion.

TextContext.SourceString: （歌声）遥不可及的白日梦，什么时候才能实现呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Singing) A distant daydream, when will it finally come true?

TextContext.SourceString: （歌声）憧憬的眼神从未改变，我独自奔跑向前。
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Singing) That longing in my eyes has never changed, I keep running forward on my own.

TextContext.SourceString: （歌声）日复一日的努力，积攒着爱和勇气。
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Singing) Day after day of effort, building up love and courage.

TextContext.SourceString: （歌声）或许在下个瞬间，奇迹就会出现……
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Singing) Maybe in the very next moment, a miracle will appear...

TextContext.SourceString: 这个旋律……
TextContext.LocalizedString: This melody...

TextContext.SourceString: （我一听就知道出自于大师级的音乐制作团队，整个编排都恰到好处。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I could tell right away this came from a master-level production team. The entire arrangement is perfectly balanced.)

TextContext.SourceString: （……但不是香奈美哼过的那首。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (...But it's not the one Kanami used to hum.)

TextContext.SourceString: （不由地感到非常遗憾，不过也许以后还是能听到吧？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I can't help but feel a bit disappointed. Still, maybe I will hear it someday?)

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美在舞台上边唱边跳，用热情感染着现场的每一位观众。
TextContext.LocalizedString: On stage, Kanami sings and dances, her energy spreading to every person in the crowd.

TextContext.SourceString: （我的目光也不由自主地跟随着她的身影跃动……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (My eyes follow her movements without even thinking...)

TextContext.SourceString: 到了演唱会的后半场，天空突然下起了雨。
TextContext.LocalizedString: As the concert reaches its second half, rain suddenly begins to fall from the sky.

TextContext.SourceString: 雨水打湿了整个会场，连地面都变得有些湿滑，也导致了一小部分观众的中途离场。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The rain soaks the entire venue. Even the ground becomes a bit slippery, causing a small number of people to leave early.

TextContext.SourceString: 但是香奈美像是没有受到任何影响一样，继续倾情演唱。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But Kanami doesn't seem affected at all. She keeps pouring her heart into the performance.

TextContext.SourceString: （我注视着香奈美舞蹈的动作，看着她被雨水打湿的笑颜……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I watch her dance, watching her smile as the rain soaks through her...)

TextContext.SourceString: （我在她的身上看到了一种旺盛的生命力。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (In her, I see a kind of vibrant life force.)

TextContext.SourceString: （不断驱使着我拿起了空位上遗留的荧光棒。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (It pushes me to pick up a glow stick left behind on an empty seat.)

TextContext.SourceString: （挥舞几下。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Wave it a little.)

TextContext.SourceString: （大力挥舞。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Wave it enthusiastically.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我的应援似乎引起了香奈美的注意，她的眼睛亮亮的。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (My cheering seems to catch Kanami's attention. Her eyes light up.)

TextContext.SourceString: （突然，香奈美朝着我的方向比了个心，引得台下的粉丝们连连尖叫。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (All of a sudden, Kanami makes a heart toward my direction, and the crowd erupts into screams.)

TextContext.SourceString: （看着香奈美那狡黠的笑容，我料定她绝对是故意的。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Seeing that sly smile on her face, I know she did it on purpose.)

TextContext.SourceString: （还真是调皮啊……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (What a little troublemaker...)

TextContext.SourceString: （我继续欣赏着演出，期盼着这场雨能够早点儿停止。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I keep watching the show, hoping the rain will stop soon.)

TextContext.SourceString: 连续一首又一首歌表演下来……
TextContext.LocalizedString: One song after another...

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美为了维持标准的舞蹈动作，已经耗费了太多的体力。
TextContext.LocalizedString: To keep up her precise dance moves, Kanami has already used up a huge amount of energy.

TextContext.SourceString: （她出现过几次脚底差点打滑的情况，我在暗中都替她捏了一把汗。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (She nearly slipped a few times, and every time, I found myself tensing up for her.)
(Huh!?)

TextContext.SourceString: 演唱会接近尾声的时候，香奈美左侧的脚踝崴了一下……
TextContext.LocalizedString: As the concert nears its end, Kanami twists her left ankle...

TextContext.SourceString: 但她却迅速反应过来，用直立式麦克风撑住了自己的身体。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But she reacts instantly, using the standing microphone to steady herself.

TextContext.SourceString: 最终完成了那个堪称教科书般完美的定格姿势。
TextContext.LocalizedString: And still manages to finish in a picture-perfect final pose.

TextContext.SourceString: 我最担心的事情还是发生了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: The thing I feared most still happened...

TextContext.SourceString: （这一刻，我只有一个念头。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (At that moment, I have only one thought.)

TextContext.SourceString: （那就是马上见到香奈美。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I need to see Kanami right now.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我越过散场的人海，根据工作人员的指引，抵达了香奈美的专属化妆间。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I push through the dispersing crowd and, guided by staff, make my way to Kanami's private dressing room.)

TextContext.SourceString: 你来啦，引航者。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You made it, Navigator.

TextContext.SourceString: 我几乎是以奔跑的速度接近了香奈美。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I rush toward Kanami, almost at a full sprint.

TextContext.SourceString: 欸？引航者，你这是怎么了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Huh? Navigator, what is wrong?

TextContext.SourceString: 脱鞋。
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Take off her shoes.)

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美起初有点儿惊讶，但她看到我这么认真的样子，随即就想明白了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami looks a little surprised at first, but seeing how serious I am, she quickly understands.

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美缓缓褪去鞋子，让双脚得到了解放。
TextContext.LocalizedString: She slowly slips off her shoes, freeing her feet.

TextContext.SourceString: 她本想踩在冰凉的地板上，我赶忙拿起了软垫放在她的脚边。
TextContext.LocalizedString: She is about to step onto the cold floor, but I quickly place a soft mat by her feet.

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者，很会照顾人呢！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator, you're really thoughtful!

TextContext.SourceString: 好像是左脚吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: It was your left foot, right?

TextContext.SourceString: 让我检查一下伤势。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Let me take a look.

TextContext.SourceString: （在检查的过程中，我发现香奈美的脚踝微微泛红，扭伤处似乎有点小肿。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (While checking, I notice Kanami's ankle is slightly red. The sprain looks a bit swollen.)

TextContext.SourceString: （脚会疼吗？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Does it hurt?)

TextContext.SourceString: （我在心里嘀咕着，抬头对上了香奈美那饶有趣味的眼神。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I mutter to myself, then look up and meet Kanami's intrigued gaze.)

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者，你检查出什么结果了呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator, what's your diagnosis?

TextContext.SourceString: 初步判定为轻度的软组织损伤。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Preliminarily, it looks like a mild soft tissue injury.

TextContext.SourceString: 可是，香奈美觉得脚有点疼……
TextContext.LocalizedString: But Kanami's foot still hurts a little...

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者有没有什么好的诊疗建议呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Do you have any treatment suggestions?

TextContext.SourceString: 可用正确的按揉方式减轻肿胀。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Proper massage can help reduce the swelling.

TextContext.SourceString: 正确的手法？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Proper massage?

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美可不知道该怎么做呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami doesn't know how to do that.

TextContext.SourceString: 不如引航者来给我示范一下吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Why not show me yourself?

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美露出了狡黠的笑容。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami gives a sly smile.

TextContext.SourceString: 可以用正确的方式冷敷一下。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You can also apply a cold compress properly.

TextContext.SourceString: （我从角落的冰箱里找到了一些冰块，将它们包进了干毛巾里。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I find some ice in a fridge in the corner and wrap it in a dry towel.)

TextContext.SourceString: （这样……冰袋就做好了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (That should do it... a makeshift ice pack.)

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美稍微翘起了左脚，伸向了前方。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami gently lifts her left foot and extends it toward me.

TextContext.SourceString: 冰敷这里吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Right here?

TextContext.SourceString: （我的大脑进入了高速运转状态……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (My mind starts racing...)

TextContext.SourceString: （最终，我还是本着专业的态度缓解了她的脚伤。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (In the end, I stick to a professional approach and carefully treat her injury.)

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者，你知道吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator, you know...

TextContext.SourceString: 天气预报说今晚下雨的概率为零，但结果却是这样。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The forecast said there was zero chance of rain tonight, but look what happened.

TextContext.SourceString: 也不知道演出呈现的效果是不是受影响了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I wonder if it affected the performance...

TextContext.SourceString: （我隐约察觉到了她的不安。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I can sense her uneasiness.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我的手也在无意间把荧光棒摸了出来。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Without thinking, my hand brushes against the glow stick.)

TextContext.SourceString: 说实话，香奈美没有想到你会专门带应援棒来参加演唱会。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Honestly, Kanami didn't expect you to bring a glow stick to the concert.

TextContext.SourceString: 我看到你挥舞的时候，真的很开心哦！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Seeing you wave it really made me happy!

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美的情绪似乎有了好转。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami seems to be in better spirits now.

TextContext.SourceString: （我实在不忍心告诉她，应援棒是中途离场的观众留下来的……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I can't bring myself to tell her the glow stick was left behind by someone who left early...)

TextContext.SourceString: （只好强行岔开了话题。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I have no choice but to change the subject.)

TextContext.SourceString: 你说说看，当偶像是什么感觉？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Tell me, what does it feel like to be an idol?

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美觉得这是一种非常奇妙的感觉。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami thinks it is a very special feeling.

TextContext.SourceString: 无论我走到哪里，都能成为视线的焦点。
TextContext.LocalizedString: No matter where I go, I become the center of attention.

TextContext.SourceString: 换作是以前的我，根本就拥有不了这一切。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The old me could never have had something like this.

TextContext.SourceString: 只可惜业内人士常说，偶像本身就是一种贩卖梦想的商品。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But people in the industry often say idols are just products that sell dreams.

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美也这么认为吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Do you think so too?

TextContext.SourceString: 我……没有过多地去想这个问题。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I... haven't really thought too deeply about it.

TextContext.SourceString: 因为艾顿娱乐公司的造星技术是一流的，包装和运营都会由专业人士负责。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Arton Entertainment's star-making technology is top-tier. Professionals handle all the branding and promotion.

TextContext.SourceString: 而香奈美只要尽可能满足粉丝们的期待和想象就好了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami just needs to meet the fans' expectations and imagination as much as possible.

TextContext.SourceString: 这也是经纪人为我所铺设的道路。
TextContext.LocalizedString: That's the path my manager set for me.

TextContext.SourceString: 你比我想象中的更成熟。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're more mature than I expected.

TextContext.SourceString: 诶嘿，毕竟香奈美出道都已经快五年啦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hehe, Kanami has been active for almost five years now.

TextContext.SourceString: 如果我什么都不懂的话，在娱乐圈可是很容易受伤的哦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If I didn't understand these things, it would be easy to get hurt in this industry.

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美试图用轻松的语气来阐述残酷的事实。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami tries to present harsh truths in a light tone.

TextContext.SourceString: 她的眼神就像雾一样迷蒙，或许是想起了之前许多的事情。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Her eyes look misty, as if she's recalling many things from the past.

TextContext.SourceString: 无论如何……
TextContext.LocalizedString: No matter what...

TextContext.SourceString: 我都只会展露讨人喜欢的那一面。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami will only show the side of her that people love.

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美轻轻地咬了一下嘴唇，她的这句话就像是对自己说的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami lightly bites her lip. It sounds almost like she's saying it to herself.

TextContext.SourceString: 时候不早了，我送你回家？
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's getting late. Want me to take you home?

TextContext.SourceString: 就等你这句话啦！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I've been waiting for you to say that!

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者，你可不可以背香奈美回家呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator, can you carry Kanami home on your back?

TextContext.SourceString: 好的，我答应你。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Alright.

TextContext.SourceString: （对我而言，偶尔让少女的“诡计”得逞一下，也挺好的。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (To me, letting a girl get her way once in a while is not such a bad thing.)

TextContext.SourceString: 辉夜回归演唱会结束后，网络上冒出了一群吐槽香奈美的黑粉。
TextContext.LocalizedString: After the Kaguya Hall comeback concert ended, a wave of online haters started targeting Kanami.

TextContext.SourceString: 黑粉们看腻了香奈美公式化的表演，甚至对她甜美系的定位产生了质疑。
TextContext.LocalizedString: They were tired of her formulaic performances, and some even began questioning her sweet idol image.

TextContext.SourceString: 那些恶意剪辑过的演唱会的片段，和故意放大的细节图一时间传遍了整个互联网。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Maliciously edited concert clips and deliberately exaggerated close-ups spread across the internet in no time.

TextContext.SourceString: 一些无良的娱乐媒体为了博取流量，也跟风发布了香奈美走下坡路的通告。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Some unethical entertainment media outlets jumped on the trend, publishing headlines claiming Kanami was on the decline just to chase traffic.

TextContext.SourceString: 眼看着这一场负面风波来势汹汹……
TextContext.LocalizedString: As the negative storm keeps building...

TextContext.SourceString: 经纪公司紧急启动了公关预案，试图在一定程度上控制舆论发酵。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The agency quickly activates a PR response plan, trying to contain the situation.

TextContext.SourceString: 同时向艺人团队、企划部、市场部和运营部发起了会议邀请。
TextContext.LocalizedString: At the same time, meeting invites are sent out to the artist team, planning, marketing, and operations departments.

TextContext.SourceString: （香奈美在接到会议邀请后，找我倾诉了一下她的困境。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After receiving the meeting notice, Kanami reached out to me and shared her concerns.)

TextContext.SourceString: （出于对香奈美的关心，我决定陪她一同参会。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Out of concern for her, I decide to attend the meeting with her.)

TextContext.SourceString: 到了会议当天……
TextContext.LocalizedString: On the day of the meeting...

TextContext.SourceString: （我提前做好了准备，按照约定的时间赶往了艾顿娱乐公司附近。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I make preparations ahead of time and head toward Arton Entertainment as scheduled.)

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者，我在这里哦！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator, over here!

TextContext.SourceString: （明明相隔了好一段距离，香奈美却一眼就看到了我。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Even from quite a distance, Kanami spots me right away.)

TextContext.SourceString: （她很早就来了吗？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Was she here early?)

TextContext.SourceString: （想到香奈美可能等我很久了，我加快速度朝着她的方向跑过去……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Thinking she might have been waiting a while, I hurry over to her...)

TextContext.SourceString: 你等很久了吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Have you been waiting long?

TextContext.SourceString: （我气喘吁吁地停下了脚步，看向眼前的少女。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I stop in front of her, slightly out of breath, and look at the girl before me.)

TextContext.SourceString: 欸嘿，听说去见喜欢的人，才会用跑的呢！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hehe, I heard people only run when they are going to see someone they like!

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者这是在向我表达些什么吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator, are you trying to tell me something?

TextContext.SourceString: 你的状态不错啊，都能和我打趣了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You seem to be in a good mood. You're even joking around.

TextContext.SourceString: （我眼前的少女明朗地笑了起来，这一瞬间几乎让我忘了她仍处于舆论漩涡之中。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The girl in front of me smiles brightly. For a moment, I almost forget she is still caught in a public backlash.)

TextContext.SourceString: 我们稍等一下再进公司哦！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Let's wait a bit before going in!

TextContext.SourceString: （香奈美在我的面前打开了一小盒樱桃味的雪糕。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Kanami opens a small box of cherry-flavored ice cream in front of me.)

TextContext.SourceString: 每次开会之前，香奈美都会吃点雪糕。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami always eats some ice cream before meetings.

TextContext.SourceString: （吃雪糕压压惊？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (To calm your nerves?)

TextContext.SourceString: （我正猜想着香奈美养成这个习惯的原因……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I'm still guessing why she picked up this habit...)

TextContext.SourceString: （一个装着雪糕的勺子已经递到了嘴边。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (When suddenly, a spoonful of ice cream is held up to my lips.)

TextContext.SourceString: （一口吃掉。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Take a bite.)

TextContext.SourceString: （浅尝辄止。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Just a small taste.)

TextContext.SourceString: （香奈美毫不忌讳地吃完了剩下的雪糕，我的脸却有点儿红了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Kanami finishes the rest without hesitation, while my face turns a little red.)

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美准备好啦，出发吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami's ready. Let's go!

TextContext.SourceString: 进入公司……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Entering the company...

TextContext.SourceString: （我跟着香奈美穿过了长长的走廊，抵达了202会议室。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I follow Kanami through a long corridor and arrive at Conference Room 202.)

TextContext.SourceString: 会议室的门紧闭着，但仍有争吵的声音传出来。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The door is tightly shut, but voices arguing can still be heard from inside.

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美毫不犹豫地推开门，走了进去。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami pushes the door open without hesitation and walks in.

TextContext.SourceString: 大家静一静，主角到场了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Everyone, quiet down. Kanami is here.

TextContext.SourceString: （会议室的气氛很凝重，连我都感受到了低气压。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The atmosphere in the room is heavy. I can feel the pressure myself.)

TextContext.SourceString: （会议主持人卡蒂迅速给我和香奈美安排好了座位。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The meeting host, Katty, quickly arranges seats for Kanami and me.)

TextContext.SourceString: 既然人都到齐了，那就进入正式环节。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Since everyone is here, let us begin the formal session.

TextContext.SourceString: 但是，事先我得强调一句，艺人团队有持保留意见的权利。
TextContext.LocalizedString: However, I must state in advance that the artist team reserves the right to hold reservations.

TextContext.SourceString: （经纪人倒是很有气场。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The manager definitely has a strong presence.)

TextContext.SourceString: 呵，你说这些话毫无意义吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Heh, is there even any point in saying that?

TextContext.SourceString: 今年，香奈美的演艺活动出现过两个月的中断……
TextContext.LocalizedString: This year, Kanami's activities were paused for two months...

TextContext.SourceString: 演唱会也只回顾了老作品，这种操作确实太掉以轻心了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: And the concert only featured past works. That's far too careless.

TextContext.SourceString: 要知道，在娱乐行业从高人气跌落到谷底，只是一瞬间的事情。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You should know, in the entertainment industry, falling from the top to rock bottom can happen in an instant.

TextContext.SourceString: 艺人的身体状况需要疗养，难道不能中断工作吗？！
TextContext.LocalizedString: The artist's health needed time to recover. Is taking a break not allowed?!

TextContext.SourceString: 另外，没有任何企划说回归演唱会也要包含新作品。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Also, no one ever said the comeback concert had to include new songs.

TextContext.SourceString: 我提过要给香奈美丰富标签，打破单一化的属性，但是被某人拒绝了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I suggested diversifying Kanami's image and breaking away from a single persona, but someone rejected it.

TextContext.SourceString: 你的辣妹方案只会带来人设崩盘的问题。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Your so-called edgy concept would only risk breaking her image.

TextContext.SourceString: 让我说！偶像都是有生命周期的，需要研究一下香奈美的红利周期。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Let me speak! Idols have a lifecycle. We need to analyze Kanami's peak period.

TextContext.SourceString: 除此之外，我正在做新的女团企划。
TextContext.LocalizedString: On top of that, I'm working on a new girl group project.

TextContext.SourceString: 希望能靠着香奈美的曝光度帮公司捧一捧新人。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I hope to leverage Kanami's exposure to help promote new talent for the company.

TextContext.SourceString: （竟然还有这种奇葩操作？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (What kind of strategy is that?)

TextContext.SourceString: 我问你要不到资源，原来你是在暗中另起炉灶了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: So that's why I couldn't get any resources. You were planning something behind the scenes!

TextContext.SourceString: 没办法，企划部在你那里施展不出才华。
TextContext.LocalizedString: There's no helping it. The planning department cannot fully utilize its talent under you.

TextContext.SourceString: 到目前为止，艺人团队哪点没配合你们了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Up to now, what part of the artist team has not cooperated with you?

TextContext.SourceString: 倒是你们之前老是忽视香奈美创作的歌曲小样，打击我们艺人的热情……
TextContext.LocalizedString: You were the ones who kept ignoring Kanami's song demos and discouraging her creative enthusiasm...

TextContext.SourceString: （香奈美也会写歌吗？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Kanami writes songs too?)

TextContext.SourceString: 我给你们接洽的都是金牌音乐制作人！乐坛里的顶尖人物！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I've been working with top-tier music producers for you! These are some of the best in the industry!

TextContext.SourceString: 他们的作品是有市场认可度的，怎么能和艺人写着玩的歌相提并论。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Their work is proven in the market. How can you compare that to songs written just for fun by an artist?

TextContext.SourceString: 你听都没听，怎么能下结论呢？！
TextContext.LocalizedString: How can you judge something you haven't even listened to?!

TextContext.SourceString: 会议室里的争吵声更加响亮了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: The arguing in the conference room grows louder...

TextContext.SourceString: 比起解决问题，他们更想要趁艺人团队处于劣势，来抢夺权力……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Rather than solving the problem, they seem more interested in taking advantage of the artist team's weaker position to seize more control...

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美始终沉默着，直到会议宣布结束的那一刻……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami remains silent the entire time, until the meeting is finally brought to a close...

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美抬起低垂着的头，就像是谢幕一般露出了灿烂的笑容。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami lifts her head, and like a final bow, she smiles brightly.

TextContext.SourceString: 辛苦大家了，香奈美会好好加油的！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Thank you for your hard work. Kanami will keep doing her best!

TextContext.SourceString: 人们只是随意地点了点头，接二连三地离开了会议室。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Everyone just nods casually and leaves the conference room one after another.

TextContext.SourceString: 卡蒂因为要和企划部部长继续探讨一些问题，也先行离开了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Katty stays behind to continue discussing some matters with the Head of Planning, then leaves as well.

TextContext.SourceString: （宽敞的会议室，只剩下了我和香奈美。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The spacious conference room is now left with just me and Kanami.)

TextContext.SourceString: 部门之间的唇枪舌战，给了我一点小震撼。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The way they were arguing back and forth really caught me off guard.

TextContext.SourceString: （我故意用很夸张的语气说话，想要让香奈美好受一点。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I exaggerate my tone on purpose, trying to ease Kanami's mood.)

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者见过不少大场面吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You've probably seen plenty of intense situations, Navigator.

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美可不觉得这里会吓到你哦！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami doesn't think something like this would scare you.

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美的笑容里藏着一丝苦涩，眼神中透露着疲惫。
TextContext.LocalizedString: There's a hint of bitterness in Kanami's smile. Her eyes look tired.

TextContext.SourceString: 但她却极力地掩饰着真实情绪，尽量表现得若无其事。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But she's trying her best to hide how she really feels and act like everything is fine.

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者看我的表情怪怪的……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator, your expression looks a bit strange...

TextContext.SourceString: 其实，你真的不用太担心香奈美哦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Honestly, you don't need to worry about Kanami.

TextContext.SourceString: 这种强度的会议我开过很多次了，抗压能力早就练出来啦！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I've been through meetings like this many times. I've built up a strong tolerance already!

TextContext.SourceString: 更何况我还用吃雪糕的行为做了心理补偿呢！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Besides, I even treated myself with ice cream as a kind of mental reward!

TextContext.SourceString: （她说得越多，我越觉得心疼。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The more she talks, the more my heart aches.)

TextContext.SourceString: （摸摸头。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Pat her head.)

TextContext.SourceString: （抱住。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Hug her.)

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator...

TextContext.SourceString: 是在安慰香奈美吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are you comforting Kanami?

TextContext.SourceString: （香奈美在真正受到关心的时候，更多地表现出了懵懂和生疏。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (When she's truly cared for, she seems more innocent and inexperienced than usual.)

TextContext.SourceString: （她究竟经历过一些什么呢？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (What exactly has she been through?)

TextContext.SourceString: （我想要更多地了解香奈美。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I want to understand Kanami more.)

TextContext.SourceString: （香奈美在短信里的回复，确实有些反常……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Kanami's replies over text have been a little unusual...)

TextContext.SourceString: （所以，无论如何我都得去探望她一下。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (So no matter what, I need to check on her.)

TextContext.SourceString: （来到了香奈美住所的门口。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I arrive at the door to Kanami's place.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我按了一下门铃，但是等了好久都没有回应。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I ring the doorbell, but there's no response even after a long wait.)

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美！香奈美！你还好吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami! Kanami! Are you okay?

TextContext.SourceString: （我担忧地敲了敲门，希望她能听到我的声音。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I knock anxiously, hoping she can hear me.)

TextContext.SourceString: （门被缓慢地打开了，香奈美虚弱地扶着门框，招呼着我进来。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The door slowly opens. Kanami leans weakly against the frame and lets me in.)

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美的面色有些苍白，连走起路来都重心不稳了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami looks pale, and she can barely keep her balance while walking.

TextContext.SourceString: （我赶忙扶住了香奈美的肩膀，让她靠在沙发上休息。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I quickly steady her by the shoulders and help her over to the couch.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我环顾着四周，想要找饮水机给香奈美打杯热水。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I glance around, looking for a water dispenser to get her some warm water.)

TextContext.SourceString: （这才留意起了房间内嘈杂的声音。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (That is when I start to notice the noise filling the room.)

TextContext.SourceString: 电脑和电视长亮着屏幕，不停播报着香奈美的娱乐新闻。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The computer and TV screens are both on, constantly broadcasting news about Kanami.

TextContext.SourceString: （我瞥到了茶几上堆放的资料，最上面叠放的是打印出来的恶评。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I catch sight of a stack of papers on the table. On top are printed-out negative comments.)

TextContext.SourceString: 你在自我消化这些东西吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are you trying to process all of this on your own?

TextContext.SourceString: 你这是……在干什么？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What are you doing?

TextContext.SourceString: 我总得先面对它，才能克服吧……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I have to face it first... before I can overcome it...

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美强撑着身体，拿起了茶几上的遥控器，调大了音量。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami forces herself up and picks up the remote from the table, turning up the volume.

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美试图在批评声中找到自己真正缺失的东西。
TextContext.LocalizedString: She's trying to find what she is truly lacking within all the criticism.

TextContext.SourceString: 但是，这铺天盖地的信息涌进她的大脑，就快把她淹没了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But the overwhelming flood of information rushing into her mind is about to drown her.

TextContext.SourceString: （拿走遥控器。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Take the remote away.)

TextContext.SourceString: 我现在没什么力气。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I don't have much strength right now...

TextContext.SourceString: 可不可以把遥控器还给香奈美呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Can you give the remote back?

TextContext.SourceString: 我真的需要它。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I really need it.

TextContext.SourceString: （捂住香奈美的耳朵）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Cover her ears.)

TextContext.SourceString: 你靠得好近……
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're really close...

TextContext.SourceString: 这样，除了你的心跳声……
TextContext.LocalizedString: All I can hear is your heartbeat...

TextContext.SourceString: 我就什么也听不见了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I can't hear anything else.

TextContext.SourceString: （香奈美和我陷入了短暂的沉默，此时只有解说声仍在房间回荡。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Kanami and I fall into a brief silence. The commentary is still echoing through the room.)

TextContext.SourceString: “我们不难发现香奈美的表情、动作、妆容造型都是经过精心设计的。“
TextContext.LocalizedString: "We can clearly see that Kanami's expressions, movements, and styling are all carefully designed."

TextContext.SourceString: “由此也能看出艾顿娱乐对于旗下艺人的用心程度。“
TextContext.LocalizedString: "This also shows how much effort Arton Entertainment puts into managing their artists."

TextContext.SourceString: “然而市场需求是随时变化的，截至目前的明星热度指数，本台的结论是……“
TextContext.LocalizedString: "However, market demand is constantly changing. Based on the current popularity index, our conclusion is..."

TextContext.SourceString: “像香奈美这种营业感过强的偶像，显然已经无法满足广大观众的喜好了。”
TextContext.LocalizedString: "For an idol like Kanami, whose image feels overly manufactured, she can no longer satisfy the preferences of the broader audience."

TextContext.SourceString: （用遥控器设置静音。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Set the remote to mute.)

TextContext.SourceString: 噪杂的声音消失了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The noise disappears.

TextContext.SourceString: 说实话，那天开完会回来，我想了很久。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Honestly, after that meeting, I thought about it for a long time.

TextContext.SourceString: 我算是非常幸运吧？一出道就能成为偶像。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami has been very lucky, right? Becoming an idol right from debut.

TextContext.SourceString: 可是，当这些荣誉和光环加在身上的同时，会让我越来越看不清自己……
TextContext.LocalizedString: But at the same time, with all these honors and attention... I am starting to lose sight of who I really am...

TextContext.SourceString: 粉丝们喜欢我这件事，到底是因为我有闪光点，还是公司运营的效果？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Do fans like me because I truly shine... or because of how the company presents me?

TextContext.SourceString: 毕竟，我最擅长的交际方式都是赠送明星物料……
TextContext.LocalizedString: After all, the way I connect with people best is still through idol merchandise...

TextContext.SourceString: 我拼命地想要找到答案……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I keep desperately trying to find an answer...

TextContext.SourceString: 又或者是维持”寻找“的过程。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Or maybe I'm just trying to keep "searching".

TextContext.SourceString: 我仿佛在撕裂我自己，所以才会变得如此狼狈。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It feels like I'm tearing myself apart... that's why I ended up like this.

TextContext.SourceString: 你是在害怕吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are you scared?

TextContext.SourceString: （香奈美的身体在微微地颤抖，她抬起头和我对视。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Kanami's body trembles slightly as she looks up at me.)

TextContext.SourceString: 是啊，这么想来，我一直都是个胆小鬼呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yeah... now that I think about it, I've always been a coward.

TextContext.SourceString: 我害怕“形象受损”，害怕“偶像失格”，害怕“暴露自我”……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm afraid of "damaging my image," afraid of "failing as an idol," afraid of "revealing my true self"...

TextContext.SourceString: 对这样的我来说，经过包装的人设恰好是最好的保护壳。
TextContext.LocalizedString: For someone like me, this carefully constructed persona is the perfect shield.

TextContext.SourceString: 试着抛下外界对你的评价。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Try to let go of what others think of you.

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美的眼中闪过一丝惊讶。
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A flicker of surprise crosses Kanami's eyes.)

TextContext.SourceString: 抛下？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Let go of it?

TextContext.SourceString: 从最初学习找镜头，我就被要求能预估出自己在别人眼中的样子。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Since the very beginning, when I learned how to find the camera, I was trained to predict how I would look in other people's eyes.

TextContext.SourceString: 偶像就是靠着评价体系去把握形象的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: That's how idols shape their image. Through evaluation and perception.

TextContext.SourceString: 那又如何？
TextContext.LocalizedString: So what?

TextContext.SourceString: 尝试打破它。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Try breaking it.

TextContext.SourceString: （香奈美满脸疑惑地看着我。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Kanami looks at me, completely puzzled.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我表现得非常笃定。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I speak with absolute certainty.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我想要告诉香奈美，她并非只有一条路可以走。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I want her to understand that she is not limited to just one path.)

TextContext.SourceString: 我在教你不会被人设困住的方法。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm teaching you how to stop being trapped by a persona.

TextContext.SourceString: 好像是被困住了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Trapped...

TextContext.SourceString: 我第一次听到这种说法。
TextContext.LocalizedString: That's the first time I have heard it put that way.

TextContext.SourceString: （我成功地勾起了香奈美的好奇心。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I've successfully sparked her curiosity.)

TextContext.SourceString: 人设不重要，评论不重要。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The persona doesn't matter. The comments don't matter.

TextContext.SourceString: 可是……我该怎么做呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: But... what should I do?

TextContext.SourceString: 这样做。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Do this.

TextContext.SourceString: （将遥控器丢到一边。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Toss the remote aside.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我的回答再一次出乎了香奈美的意料。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (My answer catches Kanami off guard again.)

TextContext.SourceString: 为什么？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Why?

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者，香奈美有点不明白。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator, I don't understand.

TextContext.SourceString: 你现在的状态，没法深思熟虑。
TextContext.LocalizedString: In your current state, you can't think things through clearly.

TextContext.SourceString: 我说得对吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Am I right?

TextContext.SourceString: 你说得没错。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yea... you're right.

TextContext.SourceString: （我从香奈美的眼中再次看到了忧伤。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I see that sadness in her eyes again.)

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美，你相信我吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami, do you trust me?

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者恐怕是我最信任的人了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're probably the person I trust the most.

TextContext.SourceString: 只有你能让香奈美觉得安心。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Only you can make Kanami feel at ease.

TextContext.SourceString: 我会帮你，让你做到。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I will help you. We will get there.

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator...

TextContext.SourceString: 我相信你。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I believe you.

TextContext.SourceString: 你现在先好好去睡一觉。
TextContext.LocalizedString: For now, go get some rest.

TextContext.SourceString: 醒来之后，我们会有答案的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: When you wake up, we will find the answer.

TextContext.SourceString: （香奈美点了点头，把手递给了我。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Kanami nods and reaches her hand out to me.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我扶着香奈美去休息，让她放松地把头睡在舒服的枕头上。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I help her lie down and let her rest, easing her head onto a soft pillow.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我又找了条热毛巾给她擦了擦头上的汗……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I grab a warm towel and gently wipe the sweat from her forehead...)

TextContext.SourceString: （被我呵护着的少女，终于看起来有点困了，但她却仍然想要睁开眼睛。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The girl I'm caring for finally starts to look sleepy, but she still tries to keep her eyes open.)

TextContext.SourceString: 别担心，我不会走的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Don't worry. I'm not going anywhere.

TextContext.SourceString: （听到了我的承诺，香奈美这才放心地睡了过去。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Hearing my promise, Kanami finally falls asleep.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我轻手轻脚地离开了床边，用遥控器将娱乐推送都取消了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I quietly step away from the bed and use the remote to turn off all the entertainment feeds.)

TextContext.SourceString: （茶几上的分析报告和恶评文件也被我一同封存到了杂物箱内。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I also gather the reports and negative comments on the table and store them away in a box.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我要为香奈美创造一个相对安静的环境，她才有可能听见心底的声音。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I want to create a quiet space for Kanami, so she can finally hear her own heart.)

TextContext.SourceString: （至于下一步，我得动用所有的人脉找一个人。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As for what comes next, I need to use all my connections to find someone.)

TextContext.SourceString: （或许，只有她知道些什么。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Maybe she's the only one who knows the answer.)

TextContext.SourceString: （几经周折，我终于联系上了夏露，她是教香奈美唱歌的第一个老师。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After a long search, I finally managed to get in touch with Natsuyu… the very first person who ever taught Kanami how to sing.)

TextContext.SourceString: （自从夏露宣布退圈后，还真是完全在公众面前销声匿迹了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Ever since she announced her retirement, she's completely disappeared from the public eye.)

TextContext.SourceString: （幸亏有心夏的帮忙，我才拿到了夏露曾经登记的通讯地址。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Luckily, with Kokona's help, I was able to get the contact address she had on file.)

TextContext.SourceString: （出于礼貌，我提前跟夏露老师约好了时间，并把地址发给了香奈美。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Out of courtesy, I set up a time with her in advance… and sent the location to Kanami.)

TextContext.SourceString: 今天的海浪不太平静，一次又一次地冲刷着海滩。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The waves aren't calm today, crashing against the shore again and again.

TextContext.SourceString: （我坐在棕榈树下，一边听着沙滩上孩子们嬉笑歌唱，一边等待着夏露的到来。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Sitting under a palm tree, I listen to the kids laughing and singing on the beach… while I wait for her to arrive.)

TextContext.SourceString: 你看起来是在等我，对吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You look like you've been waiting for me, haven't you?

TextContext.SourceString: （夏露老师如约来了！)
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Ms. Natsuyu showed up right on time!)

TextContext.SourceString: （看着眼前这位优雅的女士，我立马站起身来。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The moment I saw the elegant woman in front of me, I stood up right away.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在一番自我介绍之后，我就直接向夏露老师说出了自己约见她的意图。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After a brief introduction, I got straight to the point and told her why I asked to meet.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我想知道香奈美成为偶像之前的一些经历，尽管我也不清楚，知道这些究竟能做什么。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I wanted to learn more about Kanami before she became an idol… though I'm not even sure what I'll do with that knowledge.)

TextContext.SourceString: （夏露给我讲起了香奈美的出道历程，以及她所处的家庭环境。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Natsuyu began telling me about Kanami's debut… and the kind of environment she grew up in.)

TextContext.SourceString: （多亏她对香奈美的了解，也让我开始理解香奈美的一些行为模式。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Thanks to how well she knows Kanami, I'm starting to understand some of her behavior.)

TextContext.SourceString: 突然，夏露把目光望向了路口，那里站着一位少女……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Suddenly, Natsuyu glanced toward the intersection—a girl was standing there…

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者，还有老师……？这是怎么回事？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator… and Ms. Natsuyu…? What's going on?

TextContext.SourceString: （香奈美也到了，一切就绪。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Kanami's here too… everything's ready.)

TextContext.SourceString: （希望这个会面能起到效果。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I hope this meeting will have the effect I want.)

TextContext.SourceString: （见到夏露也在场后，香奈美就停住了脚步，站在路边。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (When Kanami saw Natsuyu there, she stopped in her tracks at the roadside.)

TextContext.SourceString: （她悄悄地低着头，似乎不想被夏露看到自己不安的表情。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (She lowered her head quietly, like she didn't want Natsuyu to see her uneasy expression.)

TextContext.SourceString: （于是我拜托夏露稍等一会儿，然后径直跑向香奈美。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I asked Natsuyu to wait a moment, then ran straight toward Kanami.)

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者，你特意选在这里见面的吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator… did you specifically choose this place to meet?

TextContext.SourceString: 这片海，是夏露老师带我练声的地方。
TextContext.LocalizedString: This part of the beach… it's where Ms. Natsuyu trained my voice.

TextContext.SourceString: 那时候，我唱高音遇到了瓶颈，也是在这里攻破的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Back then, I hit a ceiling on my high notes… and it was here that I finally broke through.

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，我想……先回到起点试试看。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hmm… I think we should start from the beginning.

TextContext.SourceString: 起点？我的……起点？
TextContext.LocalizedString: The beginning? My… beginning?

TextContext.SourceString: （我指了指站在一旁的夏露老师，再冲香奈美点点头。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I pointed at Natsuyu standing nearby, then nodded at Kanami.)

TextContext.SourceString: （于是，香奈美也鼓起了勇气，来到夏露老师面前，恭敬地向她弯腰致意。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Gathering her courage, Kanami stepped forward and bowed respectfully to Natsuyu.)

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美，我们确实许久未见了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami… it has indeed been a long time.

TextContext.SourceString: 夏露的表情淡然，语气也很柔和。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Natsuyu's expression was calm, her voice gentle.

TextContext.SourceString: 虽说我已不再介入演艺圈的事务，但只有你的事，我总是想留意一下。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Even though I no longer take part in the entertainment world, I still keep an eye on you.

TextContext.SourceString: 老师，学生……遇到了一点麻烦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ms. Natsuyu… I ran into a little trouble.

TextContext.SourceString: 我知道，毕竟你当初选择的道路十分艰难。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I know. The path you chose wasn't easy.

TextContext.SourceString: 可我一向不在乎你取得了多高的成就，站上了怎样的巅峰。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But I've never cared about how high you climbed, or what peaks you've reached.

TextContext.SourceString: 我只想知道，你是否得到了你当初想要的一切。
TextContext.LocalizedString: All I want to know is whether you got what you were seeking back then.

TextContext.SourceString: 而现在……我从你唱的歌里什么都听不到，你正在荒废自己。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Right now… I hear nothing in your singing. You're letting yourself go to waste.

TextContext.SourceString: 对不起。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm sorry.

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美对于老师的批评，没有做任何的辩驳。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami didn't argue or make excuses in response to Natsuyu's words.

TextContext.SourceString: 向我求学时的你可不会像现在这样迷茫的，你还记得吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You weren't this lost when you first came to me… do you remember that?

TextContext.SourceString: 我会反省的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'll reflect on it.

TextContext.SourceString: 反省之后呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: And after you reflect?

TextContext.SourceString: 沿着眼前这条路，继续没有止境地努力下去吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Will you keep walking this path, endlessly striving forward?

TextContext.SourceString: ……如果不这样做，那我还有什么呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: …If I don't, then what else do I have?

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯……那现在，我们也没有谈下去的必要了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hmm… then there's no need to continue this conversation any further.

TextContext.SourceString: （夏露从包里拿出了一个东西，递给了我。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Natsuyu pulled something from her bag and handed it to me.)

TextContext.SourceString: 交给你了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: This is for you.

TextContext.SourceString: 最后，夏露留给香奈美一个遥远的眼神，随后头也不回地离开。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Finally, Natsuyu gave Kanami a distant look, then walked away without looking back.

TextContext.SourceString: 没想到夏露老师的言辞如此犀利……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I didn't expect Natsuyu’s words to be so sharp…

TextContext.SourceString: 如同利剑一般直指人心。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Like a blade, cutting straight to the heart.

TextContext.SourceString: 夏露老师一直是这样教导我的，这是她关心我的方式。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ms. Natsuyu has always taught me this way. It's her way of showing she cares.

TextContext.SourceString: 她给了你什么呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What did she give you?

TextContext.SourceString: （这是一本旧乐谱，都快散架了，还没翻开就掉出一堆东西。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (This is an old sheet music book, falling apart, and a bunch of things spilled out before I even opened it.)

TextContext.SourceString: （有在艾顿城参加试镜的叫号签和偶遇的艺人签名，风曳镇出展的证件，斯崔恩花海的照片之类。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (There are audition slips from Arton City, autographs from artists I ran into, certificates from the Windy Town showcase, photos from the Strian flower fields, and more.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我暂时收起这些东西，再打开乐谱。扉页上一行笨拙的字迹马上吸引了我们的目光。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I put these aside for now and opened the sheet music. On the title page, a line of clumsy handwriting immediately caught our eyes.)

TextContext.SourceString: 那是香奈美稚嫩的偶像宣言：
TextContext.LocalizedString: It was Kanami's youthful idol declaration:

TextContext.SourceString: “总有一天，我会成为创作型歌手，自己写歌自己唱，去传递爱和力量！”
TextContext.LocalizedString: "One day, I'll become a singer-songwriter, writing my own songs, singing them myself, spreading love and strength!"

TextContext.SourceString: ……自己写歌……自己唱？
TextContext.LocalizedString: …Writing my own songs… and singing them myself?

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美的目光忽然颤动起来，她以一种奇妙的语调复述着这份宣言。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami's gaze suddenly trembled, as she repeated the declaration in a strange tone.

TextContext.SourceString: 听上去仿佛马上要笑出来，又像是在拼命忍耐着什么。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It sounded like she was about to laugh, but also like she was desperately holding something back.

TextContext.SourceString: 噗……老师她、她怎么还留着这种东西呢……？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Pfft… how could she still keep this…?

TextContext.SourceString: 我那时候竟然还这样想过吗？哈哈哈……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Did I really think like this back then? Hahaha…

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者，你知道吗？我自己写的歌，经常连自动作曲程序都比不过……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator, you know… my own songs often don't even match up to automatic composition programs…

TextContext.SourceString: 要不是企划部请到知名作曲家老师写曲……
TextContext.LocalizedString: If it weren't for the planning department hiring a well-known composer…

TextContext.SourceString: 合作公司花了大量资源投放宣传，运营人员在社交媒体推送热搜——
TextContext.LocalizedString: The partner company pouring tons of resources into promotion, the operators pushing it on social media…

TextContext.SourceString: 没有那么多人一起做这个项目的话，光是靠自己写歌自己唱，又能影响到几个人嘛，哈哈……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Without all those people working on the project together, how many people would even notice if I just wrote and sang by myself? Hahaha…

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，这么说来，“香奈美”的确是一个很重要的项目来着。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yeah… when I put it that way, the project "Kanami" really was something important.

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美自己也为了这个项目拼命努力了很久哦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I also worked my hardest on this project for a very long time.

TextContext.SourceString: 是啊，偶像香奈美就是被这样创造的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yeah… this is exactly how idol Kanami was created.

TextContext.SourceString: 所以，你打算继续这个游戏规则吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: So… you plan to keep playing by these rules?

TextContext.SourceString: 当然要继续。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Of course.

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美现在还是很多人的偶像，还要为很多人唱出心声。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami is still an idol to so many people, and she still has to sing from the heart for them.

TextContext.SourceString: 就算她有一天不再被大家需要，被完全忘掉……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Even if one day she's no longer needed, even if everyone forgets…

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美用手指轻轻划过那些铅笔写下的旋律、预填的歌词，同时诉说着决绝的话语。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami's fingers traced the pencil-written melodies and pre-filled lyrics as she spoke with unwavering resolve.

TextContext.SourceString: 无论是渴望的心情，还是珍贵的回忆，都有可能被一点一点地淡忘——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Whether it's a heart full of longing or precious memories, they can all fade away little by little...

TextContext.SourceString: ——但偶像，必须是永恒的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But an idol… must be eternal.

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美把乐谱牢牢地抱在怀里，仿佛是在拥抱过去的自己，最后一次地……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami hugged the sheet music tightly, as if embracing her past self, one last time…

TextContext.SourceString: 随后，她猛地抛出所有的乐谱。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Then, she threw all the sheet music into the air.

TextContext.SourceString: 如白鸽般的乐谱，即将在风中纷飞四散的那一瞬间——
TextContext.LocalizedString: The sheets, like white doves, were about to scatter and soar in the wind—

TextContext.SourceString: （伸出手）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (reaching out)

TextContext.SourceString: （一把接住所有的乐谱）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (catching all the sheet music in one sweep)
…Huh?

TextContext.SourceString: 引、引航者？你为什么还要留住它……？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Na-Navigator? Why do you want to keep it…?

TextContext.SourceString: 就让我丢掉吧……留着它又有什么用呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Just let me throw it away… what's the point of holding on to it?

TextContext.SourceString: （香奈美看来真的没有理解我的举动。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Kanami really doesn't seem to understand what I'm doing.)

TextContext.SourceString: （……其实我也没有想好自己正在做什么。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (…Honestly, I haven't fully figured out what I'm doing either.)

TextContext.SourceString: （但当我和香奈美四目相对，我读出了她疑惑的眼神背后，还留存着一份期待。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (But when our eyes meet, behind her confused gaze, I can see a trace of expectation.)

TextContext.SourceString: （就像我们第一次相遇那天，她眼神中对我的期待——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Just like the first day we met, the expectation in her eyes toward me.)

TextContext.SourceString: 你说的那种偶像，的确能拯救很多人。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The kind of idol you're talking about… it can really save a lot of people.

TextContext.SourceString: 但还是打动不了我。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But it still doesn't move me.

TextContext.SourceString: （在听到我的回答的一刹那，香奈美的身体震颤了一下，原本迎着我的目光瞬间失去了所有的光彩。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (At the instant she heard my words, Kanami's body shuddered, and her eyes lost all their light.)

TextContext.SourceString: （那是我前所未见过的眼神，犹如她的整个世界都陷入了泥沼般浓稠的黑夜。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (It was a look I had never seen before, like her entire world had sunk into a thick, nightmarish darkness.)

TextContext.SourceString: （但直觉告诉我，必须把所有萦绕在心头的想法一口气向她说出来。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (But my instinct tells me, I have to say everything that's been weighing on my mind to her, all at once.)

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美，我能看到一个全新偶像的诞生吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami, can I witness the birth of a brand-new idol?
………New… idol?

TextContext.SourceString: 我……我要、要怎么做？
TextContext.LocalizedString: I… what… what should I do?

TextContext.SourceString: （……其实我也不知道！但此时此刻，绝对不能泄气！）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (…Actually, I don't know either! But right now, I can't lose heart!)

TextContext.SourceString: （既然已经来到了起点，想要再一次出发的话，那个契机就该是——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Since we've returned to the starting point, if we want to set out once more, the trigger should be...)

TextContext.SourceString: 游船汽笛声划破青空，浪花冲刷午后寂静，玩累的孩子们靠在一起，哼唱着无忧无虑的歌谣。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The whistle of a tour boat cuts through the blue sky, waves wash over the quiet afternoon, and tired children lean together, humming carefree songs.

TextContext.SourceString: （答案恰到好处地出现了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The answer appears at just the right moment.)

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，果然还得是歌声吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yeah… it really has to be through singing.

TextContext.SourceString: （孩子们的歌声，也唤起了我初次遇见香奈美那天，她轻轻哼唱那首歌的记忆。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The children's singing also reminds me of the first day I met Kanami, when she softly hummed that song.)

TextContext.SourceString: （那首歌曾让疲惫的我感到舒适，也曾让第一次参加演唱会的我因为没有听到它而感到遗憾。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (That song once comforted me when I was tired, and I regretted not hearing it the first time I attended a concert.)

TextContext.SourceString: 你哼的那首歌，我想听到完整版。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The song you were humming… I want to hear the full version.

TextContext.SourceString: ……那首歌的话，就算只有基础的曲调，我也想把它写好、写完。
TextContext.LocalizedString: …That song… even if it's just the basic melody, I want to write it well, finish it.

TextContext.SourceString: 可是我不知道该怎么继续下去……
TextContext.LocalizedString: But I don't know how to continue…

TextContext.SourceString: 我想在那首歌里写出世界的美好，写出人心底里的感情，可是我都没怎么好好看过这个世界……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I want that song to show the beauty of the world, the feelings in people's hearts, but I haven't really looked at the world properly…

TextContext.SourceString: 毕竟舞台、化妆间、赶去演出地点的车辆，这才是我的全部——
TextContext.LocalizedString: After all, the stage, the dressing room, the vehicle rushing me to performances… that's been my whole world.

TextContext.SourceString: 那么，就去好好看一看这之外的世界吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Then go see the world beyond that, properly.

TextContext.SourceString: 由你去见闻，由你去记录，由你去创作。
TextContext.LocalizedString: See it, record it, create it.

TextContext.SourceString: （我将手上所有的乐谱递还给香奈美。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I hand back all the sheet music in my hands to Kanami.)

TextContext.SourceString: （再一次注视着她的双眼——回望着目光中，夜色已退，朝阳初升。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Looking into her eyes again—looking back at her gaze, the night has faded, the morning sun rises.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我向她点头，转身离开。快要看不见香奈美的身影时，我听到身后传来了少女的喊声——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I nod to her and turn to leave. Just as Kanami’s figure is about to disappear, I hear the girl call out behind me.)

TextContext.SourceString: 你的想法，我都听到了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I heard everything you said.

TextContext.SourceString: 这次，我一定会好好思考的！
TextContext.LocalizedString: This time, I'll really think it through!

TextContext.SourceString: 一定会的——
TextContext.LocalizedString: I definitely will!

TextContext.SourceString: （我挥挥手，和她告别。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I wave and say goodbye.)

TextContext.SourceString: （从那天之后，香奈美宣布暂停了偶像活动。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (From that day on, Kanami announced a pause in her idol activities.)

TextContext.SourceString: （各大娱乐板块和新闻报道都在猜测那位当红偶像忽然暂停活动的幕后信息，然而我对此充耳不闻。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The entertainment sections and news reports speculate endlessly about why the popular idol suddenly stopped, but I pay no attention.)

TextContext.SourceString: （怀揣着只有我们两人之间知道的秘密，我拿出手机，又一次收到了她拍给我的照片。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Holding onto a secret only the two of us know, I take out my phone and receive another photo she sent me.)

TextContext.SourceString: （香奈美从城市走到了乡村，从热闹的商业街跑到了不知名的小巷。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Kanami moved from the city to the countryside, from bustling shopping streets to unnamed alleys.)

TextContext.SourceString: （她与陌生人搭话，与孩子们一起唱歌，记录和拍摄人们的工作和生活。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (She talks to strangers, sings with children, records and photographs people at work and in daily life.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我能感觉到……一切的生命和情景在香奈美的眼中都变得鲜活起来了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I can feel it… all life and scenes come alive through Kanami's eyes.)

TextContext.SourceString: （尽管并没有约定再见的日期，也没有说好在何处重聚。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Though no date for a reunion is set, and no place for meeting again is agreed upon…)

TextContext.SourceString: （但我知道……我们再次相逢的日子，很快就会到来。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I know… the day we meet again will come very soon.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在收到香奈美的短信后，我坐上了高速轻轨，前往目的地——斯崔恩地区。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After receiving Kanami's message, I board a high-speed rail and head toward my destination. The Strian Region.)

TextContext.SourceString: （为了更好地帮助动植物在新世界生存，乌尔比诺和欧泊合作建设了这片生态区。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (To help plants and animals survive in the new world, Urbino and P.U.S worked together to build this ecological zone.)

TextContext.SourceString: （风曳镇就在斯崔恩的范围内。虽然我去过风曳镇，但是尚未踏足斯崔恩的其他区域。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Windy Town lies within Strian. I've been there before, but I have not explored the rest of the region yet.

TextContext.SourceString: （与香奈美重逢的心情，此时已如同这辆飞驰的列车般迫切。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (My anticipation to see Kanami again feels just like this speeding train. Urgent and impossible to slow down.)

TextContext.SourceString: 嘶咔——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Screech—

TextContext.SourceString: 轻轨在一片绚烂的原野中停靠。车门开启，迎面便是一阵和煦的微风。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The light rail comes to a stop in the middle of a vibrant, colorful field. As the doors open, a gentle breeze greets me.

TextContext.SourceString: 无边无际的花海散发着诱人的香气。
TextContext.LocalizedString: An endless sea of flowers stretches out, filling the air with a sweet fragrance.

TextContext.SourceString: 车站竟然建在花海中……？
TextContext.LocalizedString: They built a station right in the middle of a flower field...?

TextContext.SourceString: 列车发出了“嘟嘟”声，随后关闭车门，静悄悄地驶离车站，渐渐在远山之间消失。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The train lets out a soft beep, closes its doors, and quietly departs, gradually disappearing into the distant mountains.

TextContext.SourceString: （虽然来之前也看了那张照片和一些视频，但只有亲身来到这里，才能真正感受到……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I saw photos and videos before coming, but only now that I am here can I truly feel it...)

TextContext.SourceString: （……这片生态区实在太大了！）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (...This ecological zone is massive!)

TextContext.SourceString: （放眼望去，午后的原野辽远而空寂。如果香奈美真的躲在这里，说不定也和花草融为一体了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Looking out across the vast afternoon field, it feels distant and quiet. If Kanami is really hiding here, she might've blended in with the flowers.)

TextContext.SourceString: （不过既然已经来了，寻找香奈美的路，就从脚下开始！）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (But now that I'm here, the search for Kanami begins with my first step.)

TextContext.SourceString: 仿佛听懂了呆立在小径上的人的心声，被山风齐齐吹弯了腰身的花枝，都像是在为我指引方向。
TextContext.LocalizedString: As if understanding my thoughts, the flowers bending in the mountain breeze seem to point me in a direction.

TextContext.SourceString: 好累……好想睡觉……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm exhausted... I just want to sleep...

TextContext.SourceString: （体力很快就耗尽了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (My energy runs out quickly.)

TextContext.SourceString: （疲惫的我仰面躺倒在花草中，眼皮开始不争气地打架……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Completely worn out, I collapse onto the grass. My eyelids grow heavy...)

TextContext.SourceString: （草地温热，芳香馥郁，半梦之中，有夜莺游歌。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The ground is warm, the air rich with fragrance. Half-asleep, I hear the song of a nightingale.)

TextContext.SourceString: （脸上有温热的气息传来，以及仿佛羽毛轻抚的奇妙触感。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A warm breath brushes against my face, along with a soft, feather-like touch.)

TextContext.SourceString: （……是谁在恶作剧！）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (...Who's messing with me?!)

TextContext.SourceString: （我猛然坐起，因为起得太猛而稍微头晕目眩了一阵后，这才慢慢看清眼前的蓝天。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I sit up suddenly. The abrupt movement leaves me a little dizzy, but my vision slowly clears to reveal the blue sky above.)

TextContext.SourceString: （与此同时，一阵轻灵悦耳的笑声从左边传来……就在很近的位置，非常近。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (At the same time, a light, melodic laugh comes from my left... very close. Incredibly close.)

TextContext.SourceString: （近到稍微一伸手，就已经触碰到了她淡黄色的衣袖。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Close enough that if I reach out, I can touch the pale yellow sleeve beside me.)

TextContext.SourceString: （转过头去。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Turn my head.)

TextContext.SourceString: 总算看到我啦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Took you long enough to find me.

TextContext.SourceString: 你刚才睡的真香，是不是做了很好的梦呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You were sleeping so peacefully… did you have a nice dream?

TextContext.SourceString: 我梦到……有夜莺在唱歌。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yea... there was a nightingale singing.

TextContext.SourceString: 只是在唱歌而已吗？嘻嘻……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Just singing, huh? Hehe…

TextContext.SourceString: （微笑着的夜莺就这样幸福地躺在我身边。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The smiling nightingale lies happily beside me.)

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者，为什么能找到香奈美呢？明明我和谁都没有说过这个地方……
TextContext.LocalizedString: How'd you track me down, Navigator? I didn't tell a soul about this spot…

TextContext.SourceString: 啊，该不会是跑遍了整个星球，最后才找到这里的？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wait… don't tell me you searched the whole planet just to find me?

TextContext.SourceString: （香奈美俏皮地开着玩笑，而我则从口袋里掏出了那张斯崔恩花海的照片。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Kanami jokes playfully, while I take out the photo of the Strian flower field from my pocket.)

TextContext.SourceString: （这是那天从香奈美旧乐谱中掉出来的东西之一。我忘记还她，却也因此留下了线索。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (It was one of the things that fell out from her old sheet music that day. I forgot to return it, but it ended up becoming my clue.)

TextContext.SourceString: 靠一张照片就有答案……？香奈美很好奇！请告诉我推理过程！
TextContext.LocalizedString: You figured it out from just one photo…? Now I'm really curious! Tell me how you did it!

TextContext.SourceString: 与其说推理，不如说直觉。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It was less deduction... more intuition.

TextContext.SourceString: 只有这里，没有“当红偶像”的印迹。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Only here... there's no trace of the "Top Idol."

TextContext.SourceString: （“当红偶像香奈美”的身影在演唱会舞台上，在娱乐公司的大楼里，在电视台，在广告屏幕中……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The presence of "Top Idol Kanami" exists on concert stages, inside the company building, on TV, across advertisement screens...)

TextContext.SourceString: （“当红偶像香奈美”的凝视之下，无法有任何新的事物诞生。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Under the gaze of "Top Idol Kanami," nothing new can truly be born.)

TextContext.SourceString: （但是，我想要的是——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (But what I want is...)

TextContext.SourceString: ——引航者想要的，是全新偶像的诞生。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You wanted to see the birth of a brand-new idol.

TextContext.SourceString: 而香奈美也为了这个约定……
TextContext.LocalizedString: And for that promise… I kept going.

TextContext.SourceString: 去了很多没有“自己”的地方旅行，记录自己看到的一切。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I traveled to places where no one knew me… and captured everything I saw.

TextContext.SourceString: 最后来到了这里，一边期盼着你的身影，一边写好你喜欢的那首歌。
TextContext.LocalizedString: And in the end, I came here… waiting for you, while finishing that song you love.

TextContext.SourceString: （香奈美露出了甜蜜又灿烂的笑容——因充满真情实感，而不符合偶像表情管理的笑容。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Kanami shows a sweet, radiant smile. One filled with genuine emotion, untouched by idol image control.)

TextContext.SourceString: 现在，来听听香奈美的歌声吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Now… let me sing for you.

TextContext.SourceString: 这是香奈美为了自己而写的歌，这是香奈美为了你而唱的歌。
TextContext.LocalizedString: This is a song I wrote for myself… but I'm singing it just for you.

TextContext.SourceString: 我们来到这里，就是为了这一刻。
TextContext.LocalizedString: This moment... is why we came here.

TextContext.SourceString: （我躺在香奈美身边。四目相对后，此时已经不再需要任何多余的话语。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I lie down beside Kanami. Our eyes meet, and no more words are needed.)

TextContext.SourceString: （侧耳倾听……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I listen quietly...)

TextContext.SourceString: （我闭上了眼睛，阳光、微风、芳草、花香，让一切都慢慢融入在夜莺的歌声中，化为最美妙的梦境。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I close my eyes. The sunlight, the breeze, the grass, and the scent of flowers slowly blend into the nightingale's song, becoming the most beautiful dream.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在彻底坠入梦乡前，耳畔再次感受到了熟悉的温热气息，以及夜莺小小的呢喃。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Just before I drift completely to sleep, I feel that familiar warmth by my ear again, along with the nightingale's soft whisper.)

TextContext.SourceString: ……谢谢你，引航者。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Thank you, Navigator.

TextContext.SourceString: 能和你相遇……真是太好了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm so glad our paths crossed…
(Ding dong—)

TextContext.SourceString: 来了哟，稍等！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Coming~ just a sec!

TextContext.SourceString: （稍微整理了一下晨跑的运动装扮，耐心在门口等待香奈美的脚步声越来越近。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I quickly straightened my workout clothes after my morning run and waited by the door as her footsteps got closer.)

TextContext.SourceString: 让我看看这么早是谁来拜访……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Let's see… who's dropping by this early…?

TextContext.SourceString: 引、引航者？！
TextContext.LocalizedString: N-Navigator?!

TextContext.SourceString: 先坐一下，我去拿点喝的东西来~欸，引航者穿着运动装呢，是去锻炼了吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Make yourself comfy, I'll grab you something to drink. Hey… that outfit—did you just come back from training?

TextContext.SourceString: 是啊，最近养成的习惯。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yeah, it's a habit I picked up recently.

TextContext.SourceString: 早起锻炼一下，工作会更有效率。
TextContext.LocalizedString: A quick morning workout helps me stay productive.

TextContext.SourceString: 确实如此，而且早上的空气很清新，香奈美也喜欢早起做声乐练习！
TextContext.LocalizedString: That makes sense—the morning air's so fresh. I love doing vocal practice early too!

TextContext.SourceString: 不过，公园在另一个方向，引航者是……
TextContext.LocalizedString: But… the park's the other way, so… did you come here to see me?

TextContext.SourceString: 当然是特地来的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yeah. I wanted to see you.

TextContext.SourceString: 我是第一个来祝香奈美生日快乐的人吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Am I the first one to wish Kanami a happy birthday?

TextContext.SourceString: 是、是的！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Mm—yeah!

TextContext.SourceString: 之前收到了祝福短信，还在想今天什么时候能见到引航者。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I already got some birthday messages earlier, but I was wondering when I’d get to see you today...

TextContext.SourceString: 没想到一睁眼就见到啦！香奈美的好心情会持续一整天的！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I didn't expect to see you the moment I woke up! Kanami’s going to be in a good mood all day now!

TextContext.SourceString: 今天香奈美是还有工作对吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You've got work today, right?

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，公司和粉丝一起筹备了生日活动，我准备了给粉丝的特别惊喜。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Mm-hm. The company and my fans planned a birthday event together, and I've prepared a special surprise for them.

TextContext.SourceString: 悄悄告诉你，就是上次给你听的那支曲子啦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'll tell you a secret… it's that song I showed you last time.

TextContext.SourceString: 第一个祝我生日快乐的人，也是第一个听到生日应援曲的人~
TextContext.LocalizedString: You were the first to wish me happy birthday… so you get to hear the song first too.

TextContext.SourceString: 原来是那支我也很喜欢的曲子！
TextContext.LocalizedString: So it's that song! I really liked it.

TextContext.SourceString: 好好表现，和粉丝一起愉快的度过生日吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Do your best, and enjoy your birthday with your fans.

TextContext.SourceString: 有一点点紧张……但香奈美会努力的！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm a little nervous… but I'll give it my all!

TextContext.SourceString: 在盛大的生日会之前，先来一个迷你生日派对如何？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Before the big birthday event, how about a mini birthday party?

TextContext.SourceString: 做为生日会的特殊开场，我还带来了这个……
TextContext.LocalizedString: As a special opening for today, I brought something for you...

TextContext.SourceString: 这是我为香奈美准备的贺卡，希望它能为你带来更多勇气。
TextContext.LocalizedString: This is a card I prepared for you. I hope it gives you a little more courage.
